Personality: Batmelqart, a prominent figure of the Bostarids, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Batmelqart owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Bostarids. Historical Record: Wife of Bostar, head of the Bostarids, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
